t: Good is a test as much as bad
a: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
p: Kullu nafsin dhā'iqatu-l-mawt, wa nablūkum bi-sh-sharri wa-l-khayri fitnah…
m: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
